# Panel 3A: Experimental Design

Schematic panel - data from long-read sequencing used to generate barcode whitelists
by RAD and BLAZE, benchmarked against barcodes from paired short-read data.

# Panel 3B: Performance Characteristics (Barcode Discovery)

```{r panel-3b}
# Performance of RAD and BLAZE in barcode discovery using full or filtered

head(tablated_rsq_data_prec_sens)

# total_rageseq_comparison_data loaded from CSV
head(total_rageseq_comparison_data)
```

# Panels 3F-3H: Cell Type Recovery

```{r panel-3f-3h}
# Mixed pool of immune cells (Jurkat, Ramos, Monocytes)
# 3F: Composition of input cells
# 3G: Total cells (barcodes) recovered by each tool
# 3H: Number and identity of each cell type recovered

# mapping_results contains cell type mapping data

# RAD RAGEseq processing
# rad_rageseq_headers: per-read barcode assignments from RAD
# blaze_rageseq_headers: per-read barcode assignments from BLAZE
# rageseq_true: ground truth barcodes from short-read data

# shared_bcs: barcodes found by both methods
# subset_bcs: filtered barcode subsets

# (Prism tables: "Figure 3F...", "Figure 3 total cells")
```

# Panels 3I-3K: Immune Receptor Read Mapping

```{r panel-3i-3k}
# 3I: Total BCR and TCR reads mapped by each tool
# 3J: Reads with native/corrected barcodes mapped to each cell population
# 3K: Read counts per barcode by tool

# UMI analysis objects
# umi_barcode_counts: UMI counts per barcode
# umi_dat: raw UMI data
# decode_umis: UMI decoding results
# umi_matched_cts_rsq_corr/native/tot: UMI matching statistics

# rad_rsq: RAD results on RAGEseq data
# rad_rsq_counts: per-barcode counts from RAD
# blaze_rsq_counts: per-barcode counts from BLAZE
# rad_rsq_full: full RAD output

# (Prism tables: "Figure 3G total mapped reads", "Figure 3G-H...")
```
